title: michelia citrata
intro: Michelia citrata, commonly known as the Lemon-Flowered Michelia or Golden Michelia, is a plant species in the Magnoliaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Asia. The health benefits of Michelia citrata include its potential anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit sedative, antidepressant, and neuroprotective effects, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of Michelia citrata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of interest in traditional medicine and pharmacological research.
